children.game_version: A partner game where children spin with outstretched arms, freeze on a clap, and find a new hold.

seniors.counts: One long, two short, one long over three slow beats.
seniors.seated_version: Seated upper-body hold and arm extensions mimicking the centrifugal spin without rotation.
seniors.standing_version: Standing in place holding a stable support, practicing the long-short-short-long weight shifts without jumps.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo, elimination of jumps and rapid spins.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Crossed hands outstretched with centrifugal force, or closer position holding partner's shoulders and arms
movement_profile.footwork: Four steps distributed over three beats: one long, two short, one long
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Stationary for two or four people, or traveling counterclockwise around the room periphery with clockwise rotation around an internal axis
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: A jump or lift incorporated into the step during every measure in the second type
movement_profile.partnering: Spinning around one another with distinct holds and dramatic breaks

signature_moves.description: Spinning around a partner while holding crossed hands outstretched with centrifugal force
signature_moves.name: Centrifugal Spin

signature_moves.description: Spinning out from a hold, executing a solo spin with a hand clap, and returning to the hold
signature_moves.name: Hold Break and Clap

movement_profile.tempo_feel: High tempo giving a tossing feeling

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Sixteenth-note polska structure with four steps over three beats
music_profile.sound_description: Beats 1, 2, and 3 have almost equal stress and length, reflecting the precise rhythm of the dance steps.

teaching.formation: Two or four people in place, or couples moving counterclockwise around a room
teaching.rhythm: Three beats with almost equal stress and length
